title: Disney Legends
theme: Disney Legends: Imagineers, the Nine Old Men and the Disney Legends award
intro: [dramatic pause] Ladies and gentlemen... tonight we honor the LEGENDS! The Imagineers, the animators and the stars who built the magic. [excited] Handprints in cement, everybody. Let's go!

art.prompt: A grand moonlit plaza with a towering abstract bronze sculpture of a spiraling film strip rising into a star-tipped wand, bronze handprint plaques set into the stone pillars, warm uplighting and drifting golden sparkles, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Second Star to the Right
categories.intro: [excited] Think happy thoughts! Our film is Peter Pan, a 1953 classic animated by Walt's greatest legends.

art.prompt: A starry night sky over London rooftops with a glowing trail of golden pixie dust swirling toward a bright second star, a pirate galleon silhouette sailing among the clouds and a ticking clock on a chimney, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This tiny pixie sprinkles the pixie dust that lets the Darling children fly.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tinker Bell! [laughs] Small fairy, BIG attitude. Do NOT get on her bad side.

clues.clue: Peter Pan lives on this island, second star to the right and straight on till morning.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Neverland! [excited] Where you never grow up. Which is basically my lifestyle.

clues.clue: The crocodile that chases Captain Hook swallowed one of these, so you can always hear him coming.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a clock! [whispers] Tick tock... tick tock... RUN, Captain!

clues.clue: Disney Legend Kathryn Beaumont voiced Wendy Darling, and two years earlier she voiced this curious girl.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alice! [chuckles] Down the rabbit hole AND off to Neverland. Busiest kid in Burbank.

clues.clue: This Disney Legend, one of the Nine Old Men, animated Tinker Bell, using actress Margaret Kerry as his live-action reference.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Marc Davis! He told Margaret, we want her to be YOU. [chuckles] He later designed Haunted Mansion and Pirates gags, too.

categories.title: Walt's Animation All-Stars
categories.intro: [chuckles] Walt jokingly named his top animators after a nickname for the Supreme Court. Let's honor the Nine Old Men!

art.prompt: A 1940s animation studio desk with a glowing light table, stacks of pencil sketches of fluttering pages, a mirror for practicing expressions, sharpened pencils and a vintage cup of coffee, warm nostalgic light, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Walt's core group of legendary animators was nicknamed the Old Men. How many of them were there?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is nine! [laughs] The Nine Old Men. And they weren't even old at the time. Rude, Walt.

clues.clue: Nine Old Men member Milt Kahl animated this smooth, menacing tiger in The Jungle Book.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shere Khan! [mischievously] Milt Kahl was famous for animating the toughest characters. And the toughest tigers.

clues.clue: Frank Thomas brought back a cut scene and animated this romantic spaghetti dinner. Name the movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lady and the Tramp! [sighs] Walt almost cut it. Then he said, I hear you've got the best scene in the picture.

clues.clue: Frank Thomas and Ollie Johnston wrote this famous 1981 animation book, still called the animator's bible.
accept: the illusion of life: disney animation
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Illusion of Life! [excited] It's where the twelve principles of animation come from. Squash and stretch, baby!

clues.clue: This animator, Frank Thomas's best friend, was the last surviving member of the Nine Old Men when he died in 2008.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Ollie Johnston! He and Frank lived next door to each other for decades. Best friends till the very end.

categories.title: Emoji Legends
categories.intro: [excited] Every Disney Legend's career, squeezed into a few tiny pictures! Read the emoji, use the hint, and name the legend.

art.prompt: A colorful pop-art wall covered in floating glossy emoji-style icons of a top hat, a teapot, a tiny television and a steamboat, under a spotlight, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: 🎩🧹🐧🕺 Hint: danced with cartoon penguins as Bert
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dick Van Dyke! [laughs] Step in time! Even if that accent did NOT.

clues.clue: 🫖🌹🎶🏰 Hint: sang Tale as Old as Time as a teapot
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Angela Lansbury! [sighs] She recorded that song in just one take. ONE. TAKE.

clues.clue: 👯‍♀️🏕️💌🎭 Hint: played twin sisters in 1961's The Parent Trap
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hayley Mills! [chuckles] Lindsay Lohan got the 1998 remake. Hayley had to act opposite... herself.

clues.clue: 🐭👂📺🏖️ Hint: an original 1950s Mouseketeer who went on to Beach Party movies
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Annette Funicello! [excited] The most famous Mouseketeer of them all. M-I-C... see ya real soon!

clues.clue: 🐭✏️🚢📽️ Hint: animated Steamboat Willie almost single-handedly
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Ub Iwerks! Walt's earliest partner and a genius inventor. He later won Oscars for special effects.

categories.title: Imagineered Icons
categories.intro: [whispers] Behold... real photos of icons built by legendary Imagineers. [excited] Name the landmark!

art.prompt: A dreamy theme park skyline at golden hour combining a giant silver geodesic sphere, a snowy alpine peak, a colossal carved tree and a red-rock desert mountain, with a sleek monorail gliding through the scene, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Imagineers built this 18-story geodesic sphere as the icon of EPCOT. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! [chuckles] Some people call it the giant golf ball. Those people are correct.

clues.clue: Opened in 1959, this Disneyland mountain was home to the world's first tubular steel roller coaster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Matterhorn Bobsleds! [laughs] Watch out for Harold, the abominable snowman. He has NOT had his coffee.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

clues.clue: More than 300 animals are carved into this 145-foot icon of Disney's Animal Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tree of Life! [excited] Walk around it and you'll spot a lion, a hippo, an eagle... and probably a dozen you missed.

clues.clue: Disney Legend Tony Baxter dreamed up this wildest ride in the wilderness, a runaway mine train coaster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Thunder Mountain Railroad! [laughs] Hang on to them hats and glasses, folks!

clues.clue: Disney Legend Mary Blair designed the giant 90-foot tile mural inside this Walt Disney World hotel, which the monorail glides through.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Contemporary Resort! [whispers] Look closely and find the famous five-legged goat. Legend says Mary hid it on purpose.

categories.title: Legend Has It
categories.intro: [mischievously] Now for the award itself! How well do you know the Disney Legends program?

art.prompt: A sunlit studio plaza with rows of bronze handprint plaques on stone pillars, a velvet display case holding an abstract bronze star-tipped wand sculpture, palm trees and a classic studio water tower shape, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Disney Legends award sculpture shows Mickey's gloved Sorcerer's Apprentice hand holding one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a magic wand! [excited] With a star on top. Because Disney Legends ARE magic.

clues.clue: In 1987, this Shaggy Dog and Absent-Minded Professor star became the very first Disney Legend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fred MacMurray! [laughs] The very first Legend... and he starred in a movie about turning into a dog.

clues.clue: Since 2009, new Disney Legends have been named every two years at this official Disney fan event.
accept: d23: the ultimate disney fan event
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the D23 Expo! [chuckles] Thousands of fans cheering for their heroes. It's basically the Disney Oscars.

clues.clue: The bronze handprint plaques of the Disney Legends line a plaza at the Walt Disney Studios in this California city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Burbank! [excited] Walt's studio home since 1940. Go high-five a legend's handprint.

clues.clue: Named a Disney Legend in 1991, this actor became a coonskin-cap craze as Davy Crockett, King of the Wild Frontier.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fess Parker! [laughs] Kids across America BEGGED for raccoon hats in 1955. Raccoons were less excited.
